book.title: Nhalo ghwa Maha handa paghutyekitwe na 1 YOHANE

content: Twenga ndo bhana bha Chapanga

Nnole, ndo upalo ghwakya bhuli ghwakatupeghite Tate, kukita twenga tukemwe bhana bha Chapanga, habhu ndo mutubhegha. Kya habhu bhandu bhangannyitikila Changapanga bhangutumanya ng'obhe, kiyaha bhangummanya ng'obhe ywombe.

Apalo bhangu, hinu twenga ndo bhana bha Chapanga. Chapanga kanatubhoneha ng'obhe bhula mutupala kubhegha manjubha paghapala kuhika. Peni tungumanya kukita pakapala kuhika kangi Kilisto, tutalihwana na ywombe. Tutammona handa mukabheghite.
Ywohele ywakalidumbila ali kangughululika na kulibhika nyanyi muulongolo ghwa Chapanga handa bhula Kilisto mwakabhegha.
Ywohele ywakatenda ulemwa kanguyitikila ng'obhe malaghilo gha Chapanga, kiyaha ulemwa ndo kulema kuyitikila malaghilo gha Chapanga.
Mungumanya kukita Kilisto kakihika kughubhuha ulemwa ghwetu, na kangi ywombe Kilisto kabhegha ng'obhe na ulemwa.
Ywohele ywakabhegha papamu na Kilisto kangughendelela ng'obhe kutenda ulemwa. Peni ywohele ywakatenda ulemwa, kammona ng'obhe ywombe ebu kummanya Kilisto ndo ghani.
Basi, bhana apalo, nkotoke kupotohwa na mundu ywohele. Ywohele ywakatenda milando yinakunnogheha Chapanga kanguyitikilwa na Chapanga, kabhegha ywa maha handa Kilisto pakayitikilwa na Chapanga.
Peni ywakatenda ulemwa ndo ywa Nchipila, kiyaha Nchipila katenda ulemwa kutandila makachu. Na kwa kihokonyo aki Mwana ywa Chapanga kakihika ili kakalikanjaghane lihengo lya Nchipila.
Kila ywakabhegha mwana ghwa Chapanga kangutenda ng'obhe ulemwa, kiyaha kabhegha na matamilo gha hyono nkati yake, ywombe kangutenda ng'obhe ulemwa, kiyaha ywombe mwana ghwa Chapanga.
Kya habhu, mundu ywohele ywakatenda ng'obhe milando yakayipala Chapanga, ebu ywakampala ng'obhe nnyake, aywo ndo mwana ghwa Nchipila.
Mulipale
Llilagho limliyihwite kutandila makachu ndo ali, kukita tungunoghwa kila mundu kampale nnyake.

Nkotoke kubhegha handa Kaini kakilongohwa na yula Nhokelo, kakinkoma nnongo ghake. Hinu, kiyaha niki kakinkoma nnongo ywake? Kakinkoma kiyaha ndendelo yake yikibha hakata na ndendelo ya nnongo ywake yikibhegha ya maha.
Basi alongo bhangu, nkotoke kukangacha handa bhandu bhangannyitikila Chapanga paabhakalalila.
Twenga tungumanya kukita tuhuma mu makakala gha kiho na kuyingila muubhumi, kiyaha tunguapala alongo. Ywohele ywanga kunpala nnongo ghwaki kangutama mu kiho.
Ywohele ywakankalalila nnyake ndo nkoma bhandu, na mwenga mungumanya kukita yunakuma bhandu kabhegha ng'obhe na ubhumi ghwa manjubha ghoha nkati yake.

Kya habhu, twahotola kughumanya upalo ghwa Chapanga, kiyaha Yesu Kilisto kakighubhuha ubhumi ghwake kwakya twenga. Na twenga tungunoghwa kughubhuha ubhumi ghwetu kwakya abho alongo bhetu ahyubhaliala.

Handa mundu kabhegha na hilibhi ngenju hya apa pannima na nnongo ghwake kabhegha ng'obhe na hilibhi, peni kabhegha na mwoyo nnonopo ghwa kummonele luhungu nnyake, kaahotola kulongela kangumpala Chapanga?
Bhana apalo, tukotoke kupala kwa malagho ebu kwa ngulu ngati kwa ndendelo na hoto.
Ghwangebhegha na lyogha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga
Habhu ndo mutuhotola kumanya kya hoto kukita twenga ndo bhandu bha ghuhoto, na twaabhegha ng'obhe na lyogha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga.
Kiyaha hata patulitosite twabhene mu myoyo yetu, kukita tubhegha na ulemwa, tungubhegha na uhihimilo, kiyaha Chapanga kangumanya ghoha.
Alongo bhangu apalo, handa myoyo yetu yingututosa ng'obhe kukita tubhegha na uhokelo, basi, tungubhegha na ukangamalo muulongolo ghwa Chapanga,
na kupokela kuhuma kwa Chapanga kilibhi kitukiyupa, kiyaha tughayitikila hilo ghake na kughatenda ghala ghakaghapala.
Na ngwiliho yake ndo ayi, kukita tunhyubhalile Mwana ghwake Yesu Kilisto, na tulipale twabhene handa pakatukwilikihite.
Bhala bhoha bhaayitikila ngwiliho hya Chapanga bhangutama mu kulungana na Chapanga na Chapanga mu kulungana naywo. Twenga tungumanya kukita kangutama mu kulungana na twenga.
